title: Skill Source Intake · 科研技能来源审阅与入库

description.zh: 已实际用于本公开库新增技能的来源审阅流程：逐项核对官方 SKILL.md、依赖、许可、输入输出和 Blob SHA，以自动化检查维护档案一致性；并不执行第三方技能。
description.en: A provenance workflow used to review official SKILL.md sources, dependencies, rights, inputs/outputs and Git blob SHAs for this public catalog; it does not execute third-party skills.

zh: 准备从外部仓库正式收录研究 Skills，需要防止路径错配、热度归因错误与未经核验的使用承诺。
en: Adding individual research skills from upstream repositories, avoiding source mismatches or false claims.

zh: 在官方仓库确认真实 SKILL.md、运行依赖和授权边界，并登记 Git blob SHA。
给出中英输入、输出、环境、步骤与检查项；从唯一目录重新生成派生文件。
运行来源台账校验及页面回归测试，再进行人工精选判断。
en: Read the original SKILL.md, requirements and rights; record Git blob SHA.
Write bilingual inputs, outputs, requirements and checks, then regenerate catalog derivatives.
Run offline audit and browser checks, keeping human curation separate.

zh: 仅审核档案字段与上游来源；这不等于执行 Skill、验证效果、实时检查上游版本或安全审计。
en: Offline metadata and source review is not execution, performance validation, live upstream monitoring or security assessment.

used_in.zh: 在本公开仓库对 13 个单项 SKILL.md 进行来源和使用条件核对，并通过 GitHub Actions 的 canonical data checks 执行离线审计。
used_in.en: Applied to thirteen upstream SKILL.md dossiers in this public repository; offline audit executed in GitHub Actions canonical checks.
